text: Applying to PhD programs for **Fall 2027**: accessibility, automated program repair, and software testing.
Presented [NavA11y](/project/nava11y) in person at **ENASE 2026** in Benidorm, Spain.
Received the **ICT Division Fellowship** from the Government of Bangladesh, funding my M.Sc. thesis research.
Promoted to **Software Engineer II** at Optimizely.
My first-author full paper on [NavA11y](/project/nava11y) was accepted at **ENASE 2026**.
Won the [Optimizely Global Hackathon 2025](/awards/optimizely-global-hackathon-2025). Our team built Spotlight, a Cmd+K global search that later shipped to production.
Started my M.Sc. in Software Engineering at the University of Dhaka, advised by Dr. Kazi Sakib and Zerina Begum.
Joined **Optimizely** as a Software Engineer on the Content Marketing Platform team.
Completed my B.Sc. in Software Engineering at the University of Dhaka.
Started a remote research internship at **SEMERU Lab, William & Mary**, with Dr. Denys Poshyvanyk.
[Clippy](/project/clippy) placed **Top 6** at ICSE SCORE 2023, the Student Contest on Software Engineering.
Won **Best UI/UX** at the BUET Hackathon with [API Miners GPT](/project/api-miners-gpt).
